product_rule: If a control is visibly editable in Vision Execution, chat shall either (1) apply a registered handler to edit it directly, or (2) truthfully explain the exact UI/API operation path for relation-derived-readonly surfaces. No silent 'supported a few scalars' pretense.
implementation_model: Surface action registry keyed by (entity, surface_key, operation); handlers are shared primitives (text_set, person_assign, entity_link, checklist_row, workflow_router).

priority_tier_definitions.1: High-frequency daily edits — Lane A sequencing starts here (initiative + project + task first).
priority_tier_definitions.2: Regular but not constant — schedule after tier-1 matrix is honest.
priority_tier_definitions.3: Advanced workflows, cross-surface, session-local AI, matching/message center — explicit paths only until wired.

handler_taxonomy.text_set: Scalar or long text PATCH on parent entity
handler_taxonomy.entity_reference_set: Single entity FK PATCH (idea, initiative, project)
handler_taxonomy.entity_multi_link: Array of entity ids PATCH (assets, tasks, ideas)
handler_taxonomy.session_state_patch: Client session only — chat must disclose non-persistence
handler_taxonomy.client_local_ai_list: localStorage / client-only suggested work — disclose + offer UI deep link
handler_taxonomy.derived_readonly_explain: No PATCH — return deterministic explanation of derivation
handler_taxonomy.workflow_router: Multi-step product action (promote, create child, apply evaluation)
handler_taxonomy.core_profile_patch: PATCH core profile / primary flag via Foundation routes
